info.sub_name: 行政法及行政救濟實務

description.sub_name: 行政法及行政救濟實務
description.describe_ch: 探討行政法基本構造與法律問題，包涵公法基本法理與一般原理原則、行政處分、行政契約、法規命令與行政制裁、行政執行等；兼及司法院大法官解釋與司法判決之探討，並擇近年重要相關議題進行專題研討。
description.describe_eh: This course will examine the framework of administrative law and its related issues of remedies. Topics to be covered include legal theories and general principles of public law, administrative contracts, regulations and directions, administrative enforcement, administrative execution, etc. , as well as related Constitution Interpretations of Grand Justices Council and Judicial Judgment of administrative cases, there will be case studies based on notable topics in administrative law and remedies in recent years.

targets.describe_ch: 掌握行政法與行政救濟之基本法理
targets.describe_en: Understand legal theories of administrative law and its remedies.

targets.describe_ch: 學習對於行政法與行政救濟相關議題之法律分析與相關法理論之應用
targets.describe_en: Learning legal analysis and the legal issues related administrative law and remedies, and know how to apply legal theories in a real case scenario.

targets.describe_ch: 強化法律人在行政法學上之法律專業
targets.describe_en: The course will focus on case-based discussion on Legal theories of administrative law.

targets.describe_ch: 有助提升從事或未來擔任公務員、律師、法官及公司法務等工作之專業能力
targets.describe_en: To emphasize on lawyer's proficiency of administrative law, and to promote students' future working ability as civil service, attorneys, judges, as well as corporate legal consulates.
